name: Azeroth Companion
title: Professional Launch Edition — Onboarding, Install & Update Center
features: New professional first-visit welcome center, with shortcuts to Characters, Build Architect, Progression and Talent Forge.
Device-aware install guidance for iPhone, Android and supported desktop browsers, preserving the existing web-app manifest and icons.
Manual release checker compares the current published version to the loaded website and offers a safe reload when they differ.
New public Getting Started and Privacy & Data Guide pages explain backups, locally saved drafts, optional Battle.net connections and independent project status.
Existing Talent Forge, guided builds, World of Warcraft data integrations, media tools and the proven Discord release workflow are preserved.
